author: Ifmyante
text:
Whenever

I do take losses from time to time. Granted, I've traded so little since I began again that I haven't had any losses yet!

I'm extremely careful with entries, making sure that should my level
break, my entry point is where price will quickly retrace to before
advancing or making a deep retrace.

Tink

I'll usually take something off to make sure I can't lose.

On that GU, if I recall correctly, I took off one quarter at the red line at the bottom of the chart
